Laura — observed the same anomaly. Early findings:
- Root signal: KV-cache eviction spike around 14:30 PST due to a mis-scheduled model rollout; cache warmup failed and caused CPU-bound regen spikes on the inference tier.
- Impact: continuous token regen caused connection backpressure -> 502/504 cascade and write queue saturation.
- Current: we've toggled the problematic rollout (rollback initiated) and cleared local cache nodes, but backlog remains.

Immediate recommended actions (I can execute):
1) Emergency drain and route ~30% of Continuum traffic to us-west2 (we have capacity for a short burst). Estimated cutover time 4-7 minutes once route is authorized.
2) Temporarily enable model-variant fallback to q4_0 replicas for their route to reduce CPU overhead (5-12% quality delta tolerable for short window).
3) Increase connection pool and throttle retries at edge for Continuum's key routes (helps reduce amplifying retries).

I attached raw logs we've pulled from Continuum's ingest for the 14:30-14:45 window: continuum-sla-logs-031-raw.txt.

If authorized, I'll request the cross-region steer and execute the fallback.

— David
David Kim
Senior Site Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference

Subject: Continuum Health — incident update and next steps (us-east)

Marta / John — quick executive summary and next steps.

What happened: an internal model rollout caused an unexpected cache warmup failure in us-east which amplified retry traffic and produced elevated 5xx rates.
What we did:
- Rolled back the rollout and cleared impacted cache shards.
- Executed an emergency partial cross-region steer to us-west2 at 16:05 PST (30% of traffic) while cache warmed.
- Enabled a temporary q4_0 fallback replica for your routes to reduce CPU pressure.
- Applied edge retry throttles to stop amplification.

Current status: error rate has dropped from peak ~9% to 0.9%; p95 latency down to ~580ms. We expect full stabilization within 30–45 minutes while the cache finishes warming.

Next steps / asks:
- Please confirm you accept the temporary fallback replica for the 1-hour window.
- We're prepared to offer a one-time credit of 10% of your March invoice; Markus is finalizing approval. If you want formal acceptance for accounting, we'll push a DocuSign: https://docusign.net/DocuSign/execute?R=0a3b7c

Attachments: governance-request-form.pdf (for internal review of rollout safeguards).

If you'd like an exec bridge to review root cause and remediation timeline I can set that up; otherwise we'll follow up with a full incident RCA and a post-mortem within 48 hours.

Thanks for the patience — we'll keep you updated every 15 minutes until the route is fully stable.
